tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground — the cool card-stock behind every layer. Never pure white in Paper: white is reserved for raised paper.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A cut paper layer lifted off the ground: cards, sheets, the tab bar, the arch frame, cloud scrolls. Always paired with a shadow-* token so the edge reads.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed-in paper: text-field wells, toggle tracks, segmented-control troughs. Pair with shadow-inset.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and ornament rules. Decorative only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen (inputs at rest, unchecked toggles); 3:1+ on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥ 13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholder text, inactive tab labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥ 5.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: The night sky seen through a cut-out: arch windows, the primary button, hero panels, active tab pill. In Night it sits close to surface, so a window is always framed by surface-raised paper, never placed bare on the ground.

tokens.name: window-raised
tokens.usage: A layer inside the night window — a card or chip sitting on window.

tokens.name: on-window
tokens.usage: Moon-white text, icons, crescent and stars on window and window-raised (≥ 13:1).

tokens.name: on-window-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on window and window-raised (≥ 6.5:1).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The one warm note, taken from the embroidered band: focus ring, links, the selected date, small ornaments. Text in brass on surface or surface-raised passes 4.5:1 in both themes. Use sparingly — one brass element per view region.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet brass fill behind brass text (Badge tone=brass, highlighted day).

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on a solid brass fill — white in Paper, near-black in Night (never literal white).

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: The shaded foot of a lit paper layer: the bottom stop of the top-to-bottom light wash on ArchFrame rings and clouds (top stop is surface-raised), and back-row paper that sits further from the light. ArchFrame only.

tokens.name: sky-glow
tokens.usage: Halo of moonlight around the crescent inside a window, fading to nothing. ArchFrame only.

tokens.name: depth-shadow
tokens.usage: Colour of the shadow each paper layer casts onto the layer behind it inside a shadow box (ArchFrame rings, skyline, clouds, lace). Light comes from straight above, so these shadows always fall downward.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed / done state text and icons on surface-raised or success-soft. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; text on surface-raised or danger-soft. Always paired with a word or icon — never hue alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One greeting per screen: hero inside an ArchFrame or a splash.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles on onboarding and feature pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The moon was sighted on Tuesday evening.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting text, field hints, list secondary lines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title. Set in uppercase via text-transform; never for sentences.

styles.name: arabic-display
styles.usage: Arabic greeting paired under a display-xl Latin line. Generous leading for diacritics.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked label and field; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling buttons; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on larger screens; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Breathing room around a hero ArchFrame.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top/bottom padding of splash and greeting screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, text fields, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list groups, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Paper cards and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, tab-bar active pill, avatar discs.

shadow.note: Depth is the material. Every raised paper layer gets exactly one of these; layers stack 1 → 2 → 3 as they come forward.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Flat paper: list groups, inputs on raised paper, the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Cards and buttons — the default lift.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: The front-most layer: hero ArchFrame, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Cut-into-the-page wells: surface-sunken fields and tracks.
